| ✅ Pros | ❌ Cons |
|--------|--------|

| Easier to test and debug | Cumulative latency (sub-agent B must wait for sub-agent A to finish) |
| Fewer LLM calls → lower latency, lower costs | |

|---|---|
| Lower latency (agents run in parallel, instead of waiting) | Harder to manage dependencies and state (race condition risk) |
